name: Castillo de la Real Fuerza
text: The Castillo de la Real Fuerza (Castle of the Royal Force) is a bastion fort on the western side of the harbour in Havana, Cuba, set back from the entrance, and bordering the Plaza de Armas. Originally built to defend Havana against attack by pirates, it was not strategically located, being too far inside the bay, and instead was adopted as the residence of the Governor of Havana. The fort is considered to be the oldest stone fort in the Americas, and was listed in 1982 as part of the UNESCO World Heritage Site of "Old Havana and its Fortifications".

depictions.name: Castillo de la Real Fuerza
depictions.text: The Castillo de la Real Fuerza is a Spanish fort in Havana, Cuba. Built in 1577, the Castillo replaced a much older fort, then inadequate fort, in protecting Havana's harbor. Eventually, the Castillo too proved to be inadequate, and was converted into an official residence.
